import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def find_longest_path(graph, start, visited):
    visited[start] = True
    longest = ([], start)
    for neighbor in graph[start]:
        if not visited[neighbor]:
            path, end = find_longest_path(graph, neighbor, visited)
            if len(path) + 1 > len(longest[0]):
                longest = (path + [start], end)
    visited[start] = False
    return longest

def find_diameter_and_center(graph, n):
    visited = [False] * (n + 1)
    _, farthest = find_longest_path(graph, 1, visited)
    path, _ = find_longest_path(graph, farthest, visited)
    diameter = len(path)
    center = path[diameter // 2]
    return diameter, center

def construct_paths(graph, n):
    diameter, center = find_diameter_and_center(graph, n)
    paths = []
    visited = [False] * (n + 1)
    for neighbor in graph[center]:
        path, _ = find_longest_path(graph, neighbor, visited)

        x = 0.5 if len(path) % 2 == 0 else 0.6666666666
        paths.append((len(edge_indices), edge_indices, path[-1], path[-2], x))
